title: Certificate Terms: SR-26 Notice, Continuation, Reinstatement and Release (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
These terms state, for each Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, when an SR-26 cancellation notice is sent to the ordering state, how many days after transmission it takes effect, and the terms on which a certificate continues, is reinstated or is released.

## SR-26 notice lead days by ordering state

The SR-26 takes effect the stated number of calendar days after it is transmitted.

| Certificate | Lead days by ordering state |
|---|---|
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate | OH 10, IN 10, KY 10, VA 10, WV 10 |
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | OH 10, IN 10, KY 10, VA 10, WV 10 |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate | TN 10, MI 10, IL 15, MO 10 |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | TN 10, MI 10, IL 15, MO 10 |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate | VA 10 |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | VA 10 |

## Terms common to all six certificates

| Term | Every certificate |
|---|---|
| SR-26 sent when the insured requests cancellation | Yes |
| SR-26 sent when the policy is cancelled for nonpayment | Yes |
| SR-26 sent when Cardinal nonrenews the policy | Yes |
| SR-26 sent when the policy expires for an unpaid renewal | Yes |
| Certificate continues through renewals without refiling | Yes |
| Reinstatement filing cutoff, in days relative to the SR-26 effective date | 0 (the policy must be reinstated before the SR-26 effective date) |
| Lapsed certificate needs a brand-new filing with a new filing fee rather than a reinstatement filing | Yes |
| Release at the end of the requirement sends a notice to the state | Yes |
| Earliest release request, in calendar days after the order's required-through date | 1 |

## Worked lead-day illustration (hypothetical dates)

An SR-26 for a Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate answering an Illinois order, transmitted on 3 March, takes effect 15 calendar days later, on 18 March. The same notice answering a Missouri order takes effect 10 calendar days later, on 13 March.
